decisions.reason: The GPIO5 change already has a complete same-message MODIFY updating the LED-supplying 5V rail control from GPIO3 to GPIO5.
The GPIO5 change already has a complete same-message MODIFY updating the boost converter's enable_gpio.
Changing 5V_EN, SCL0, and SPI MOSI GPIO assignments does not alter the standalone USB power source, activation condition, capacity, or powered scope.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the 3.3V source OR-ing method, participating power sources, or source-selection behavior.
The source does not change the GPIO13 charge-status indicator, CHGLED connector, or associated resistor and population requirements.
The main-board GPIO corrections do not affect the battery connector, battery pin functions, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 destination.
The interboard connector still carries the same named SCL0 and 5V_EN signals on the same connector pins; only their ESP32 GPIO endpoints changed.
Moving SCL0 to GPIO38 does not change the I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance or location, or series-resistor policy.
The GPIO assignment changes do not affect the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology or VSYS net labeling.
The source changes main-board control GPIOs but does not change the separate LED board's count or addressable-LED requirement.
The GPIO corrections do not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
The source does not change battery temperature sensing through the J_BAT NTC connection.
